{{Recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 200 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Self-rising Flour|self-raising flour]]
* 100 g vegetable [[Cookbook:Suet|suet]]
* Finely-grated [[Cookbook:Zest|zest]] and juice of 1 small [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]]
* 1 medium [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]], beaten
* 2–4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]] or water
* 200 g red [[Cookbook:Jam|jam]] of your choice such as plum, cherry, raspberry or strawberry
* 1 pinch [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Custard|Custard]] or cream to serve.

== Procedure ==
# Stir the flour, suet, salt and lemon zest together then work to a firm [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]] with the lemon juice, egg and milk or water.
# [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|Roll out]] to a rectangle about 25 x 20.5 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]] (10 x 8 [[Cookbook:Inch|in]]) and spread jam to within 2.5 cm (1 in) of the edges. Roll up starting from a short end and seal the edges well with a little water.
# Set the roll on a sheet of well buttered [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]] and wrap, making sure you seal the ends well. If you are feeling traditional use [[Cookbook:Cheesecloth|cheesecloth]] or a shirt sleeve to steam in.
# Set in a [[Cookbook:Steamer|steamer]] and [[Cookbook:Steaming|steam]] for 2 hours.
